summary: Iteration 10: All features verified working. CRITICAL FIX: /api/tickets/note-counts endpoint now working (was causing 'Failed to fetch tickets'). Backend: 14/14 tests passed. Frontend: All tested flows working.
passed_tests: === Backend API Tests (14/14 passed) ===
GET /api/tickets/note-counts - returns 200 with dict of ticket_id -> note count (CRITICAL FIX VERIFIED)
GET /api/tickets - returns list of tickets
POST /api/tickets - creates ticket with enhanced fields (ticket_type, impact, source, due_date, estimated_hours, asset_id)
POST /api/tickets - minimal fields use correct defaults (ticket_type=incident, impact=medium, source=portal)
GET /api/invoices - returns list of invoices
GET /api/invoices/stats/summary - returns paid/unpaid/overdue counts
POST /api/invoices - creates invoice with recurring fields (is_recurring, recurring_interval, start/end dates)
POST /api/invoices - non-recurring invoice has is_recurring=False default
GET /api/clients - regression passed
GET /api/users - regression passed
GET /api/canned-responses - regression passed
GET /api/dashboard/enhanced-stats - regression passed
GET /api/settings/no-notes-threshold - regression passed
=== Frontend UI Tests (all passed) ===
Tickets Page: Loads correctly with 15+ tickets visible (no 'Failed to fetch' error)
Tickets Page: Create Ticket dialog has all 12+ Syncro/SuperOps-style fields
Tickets Page: Create ticket with all fields works (TKT-016 created via E2E test)
Invoices Page: Table shows 'Not Paid' badges in RED
Invoices Page: Create Invoice dialog has Recurring section with toggle, frequency dropdown, start/end dates
Dashboard: Operational alerts row (Revenue, Outstanding, No Notes, SLA Breaches, Low Stock, Pending POs)
Settings: No-Notes Escalation Threshold section present
Settings: Xero integration section present
Settings: Stripe section present
